# The Lamp in the Window

*Elspeth's lamp burns every night, for Osric. Bring her 25 Sea Newt Hides for clean lamp oil, and look in on Osric on the way.*

|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |

| Level | 36 |

## Objectives

- Bring 25 [Sea Newt Hide](../items/newt_hide.md) (taken)
